semantics.THERMAL_LAB: Thermal profile lower boundary/interface defined by an explicit thermal criterion or model boundary.
semantics.MECHANICAL_LAB: Mechanical weakening/base relevant to strength; not automatically a thermal isotherm.
semantics.RHEOLOGICAL_LAB: Depth where a specified rheological criterion is met.
semantics.SEISMIC_LAB: Seismic velocity/attenuation transition; no such field is bound.
semantics.COMPOSITIONAL_LAB: Compositional interface; no current ARCANA field establishes it.
semantics.MODEL_DOMAIN_BASE: Numerical truncation/boundary, not necessarily a physical interface.

consumer_roles.B6N8H_provider: Needs explicit base geometry/thickness and declared meaning/support/validity.
consumer_roles.thermal_initialization: Needs lower thermal condition/profile support; independent geometric boundary may be an input after explicit binding.
consumer_roles.Buck_thickness: Needs section-specific geometry under selected model; HWR depth or ZBASTH is not equivalent by name.
consumer_roles.thermal_evolution: Needs boundary history and model domain; physical LAB motion remains a model decision.
consumer_roles.rheology: Requires constitutive law only if chosen criterion or process depends on it.

non_equivalences: HWR zp is finite-plate thermal-model depth; a specialist mapping uses it as total ocean thermal lithosphere thickness, not universal/mechanical LAB.
ShellSet ZBASTH is separate upper-mantle/mechanical control.
Lithosphere thickness is not Buck Xe or XL.
Moho geometry does not bind material properties.

candidates.compatibility: Continental reference thickness exists; ocean HWR thickness is model-conditional; no coherent global physical LAB field.
candidates.temporal: Needs T0-T1 evolution or authorized validity; no constancy inferred.

candidates.circularity: Circular if criterion sets the same profile's basal boundary; diagnose only from an independently bounded solve.
candidates.compatibility: No complete T(z) or ARCANA criterion.
candidates.authority: Authorial criterion plus targeted validity research.
Material/rheology decision; only if selected scope requires.

candidates.circularity: Coupled, cannot be sequentially assigned without a governed method.
Low if independent of derived T/rheology.
candidates.compatibility: In principle consistent with synthetic T0 methodology; no LAB field/value ratified.
Integrated global LAB semantics and valid support unresolved.

circularity_controls: Do not use T(z) to define a basal boundary that was itself used to construct the same T(z), absent a larger-domain solve.
Do not use viscosity to define LAB and then prescribe that LAB to determine the same rheological structure without a governed coupled solver.
